titleEn: Why does your body store fat in your butt?
titleZh: 身体为什么会在臀部储存脂肪？
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Curious Kids is a series for children of all ages. If you have a question you’d like an expert to answer, send it to CuriousKidsUS@theconversation.com.
paragraphs.zh: 好奇的孩子是一个系列的所有年龄段的儿童。如果你有一个问题，你想一个专家回答，把它发送到好奇的孩子US@theconnation.com。

paragraphs.en: Why does your body store fat in your butt? - Ellen, age 8, Cambridge, Massachusetts
paragraphs.zh: 为什么你的身体会把脂肪储存在屁股里？--艾伦，8岁，剑桥，马萨诸塞州

paragraphs.en: Have you ever wondered why some parts of your body are firm, like your elbows, while other areas, like your butt, are squishier?
paragraphs.zh: 你有没有想过，为什么你身体的某些部分是坚定的，如你的肘部，而其他地区，如你的屁股，是squishier？

paragraphs.en: The difference is due to what scientists call fat distribution, and researchers are still trying to understand why bodies store fat in some places but not in others.
paragraphs.zh: 这种差异是由于科学家所说的脂肪分布，研究人员仍在试图了解为什么身体在某些地方储存脂肪，而不是在其他地方。

paragraphs.en: All animals have fat in their bodies, even insects. Bears even put on up to 400 pounds (180 kilograms) of additional body fat, the equivalent of 544 large cheese pizzas, to survive hibernation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有的动物体内都有脂肪，昆虫也不例外。熊为了在冬眠中存活下来，甚至会额外增加400磅（180公斤）的脂肪，相当于544个大奶酪比萨饼。

paragraphs.en: Fat is an important and constantly changing part of all bodies, including those of humans and our evolutionary ancestors.
paragraphs.zh: 脂肪是所有身体的一个重要且不断变化的部分，包括人类和我们进化的祖先。

paragraphs.en: What is fat?
paragraphs.zh: 什么是脂肪？

paragraphs.en: Fat, also called adipose tissue, is one kind of connective tissue that helps hold your body together.
paragraphs.zh: 脂肪，也被称为脂肪组织，是一种结缔组织，有助于保持你的身体在一起。

paragraphs.en: For a long time, scientists thought that adipose tissue was mainly a storage place for the extra energy your body doesn’t use from the food you eat. While fat is a great source of stored energy, it also has many other functions. There are even different kinds of fat.
paragraphs.zh: 长期以来，科学家们认为脂肪组织主要是一个储存你身体从你吃的食物中没有使用的额外能量的地方。虽然脂肪是储存能量的重要来源，但它也有许多其他功能。甚至有不同种类的脂肪。

paragraphs.en: Visceral fat serves as a sort of protective bubble wrap, surrounding and filling in the spaces between your internal organs. Subcutaneous fat, the layer of fat between your skin and your muscle that you can pinch, is a protective cushion and helps to keep you warm by insulating you like a coat.
paragraphs.zh: 内脏脂肪就像一种保护性的气泡膜，包围并填充在内脏之间的空隙里;皮下脂肪，你可以捏住皮肤和肌肉之间的脂肪层，是一个保护垫，帮助你保暖，就像一件外套。

paragraphs.en: Fat also produces and responds to hormones, a type of chemical messenger, to regulate how your body uses energy and to tell you when you are hungry or full.
paragraphs.zh: 脂肪也会产生激素，并对激素做出反应，激素是一种化学信使，可以调节你的身体如何使用能量，并告诉你什么时候饿或饱。

paragraphs.en: Different kinds of fat also have different jobs. White fat is the kind of fat most people are familiar with and performs the functions mentioned above.
paragraphs.zh: 不同种类的脂肪也有不同的工作。白色脂肪是大多数人熟悉的脂肪，执行上述功能。

paragraphs.en: You may be less familiar with brown fat, which is brown because it contains a lot of mitochondria: the parts of your cells that produce the energy your body needs to perform all its functions.
paragraphs.zh: 你可能不太熟悉棕色脂肪，它是棕色的，因为它含有大量的线粒体：你的细胞中产生能量的部分，你的身体需要执行所有的功能。

paragraphs.en: Not all animals have brown fat, but humans do. Scientists know that brown fat performs a special function to heat your body when you get cold. It doesn’t store energy, like white fat does, to help your body move.
paragraphs.zh: 并非所有动物都有棕色脂肪，但人类有。科学家们知道，棕色脂肪有一种特殊的功能，当你感到寒冷时，它会给你的身体加热。它不像白色脂肪那样储存能量，帮助你的身体移动。

paragraphs.en: When you were a baby, you had a lot of brown fat along your torso to help keep you warm because your body wasn’t mature enough to maintain your body temperature. As you grow older, you have less brown fat. It is only located just above your collar bone and along your major deep blood vessels, like your aorta.
paragraphs.zh: 当你还是个婴儿的时候，你的躯干沿着有大量的棕色脂肪来帮助你保暖，因为你的身体还不够成熟，不能维持体温。随着年龄的增长，你的棕色脂肪越来越少。它只位于锁骨上方，沿着你的主要深血管，比如主动脉。

paragraphs.en: Why do humans store fat where we do?
paragraphs.zh: 为什么人类要在我们所处的地方储存脂肪？

paragraphs.en: Researchers don’t know enough yet about brown fat to know why it is in just a few parts of the body. It is possible that it’s near the neck and around major blood vessels to help insulate the blood and keep overall body temperature in a healthy warm range.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员对棕色脂肪的了解还不足以解释为什么它只存在于身体的几个部位。有可能它位于颈部附近和主要血管周围，以帮助隔离血液并将整体体温保持在健康的温暖范围内。

paragraphs.en: As for white fat, there appear to be three main factors that determine where your fat gets stored: genetics, hormones and age.
paragraphs.zh: 至于白色脂肪，似乎有三个主要因素决定了你的脂肪储存在哪里：遗传，激素和年龄。

paragraphs.en: Certain genes direct fat to accumulate in the butt, while other genes tell it to collect on the torso.
paragraphs.zh: 某些基因引导脂肪在臀部积累，而其他基因则告诉它在躯干上积累。

paragraphs.en: Hormones like estrogen, which affects almost every system in all bodies but is typically higher in females, direct more subcutaneous fat to gather in the butt, thighs and backs of the arms. Cortisol, the stress hormone, seems to direct visceral fat to accumulate in the belly area.
paragraphs.zh: 雌激素会影响人体的几乎每一个系统，但女性体内的雌激素含量通常更高。雌激素会引导更多的皮下脂肪聚集在臀部、大腿和手臂背面。皮质醇，一种应激激素，似乎会引导内脏脂肪聚集在腹部。

paragraphs.en: But why isn’t fat evenly distributed throughout the body? Well, having a lot of fat around your elbows and knees would limit your ability to bend your arms and legs. Storing a lot of fat around your head would possibly put your brain at risk of overheating. Other parts of your body, like hips, butts, breasts and thighs, don’t have these risks – maybe that’s why we store fat there.
paragraphs.zh: 但为什么脂肪不能均匀分布在全身呢？肘部和膝盖周围有大量脂肪会限制你弯曲胳膊和腿的能力。在头部周围储存大量脂肪可能会使你的大脑处于过热的危险之中。身体的其他部位，如臀部、臀部、乳房和大腿，则没有这些危险--也许这就是我们在那里储存脂肪的原因。

paragraphs.en: Why do people have fat at all?
paragraphs.zh: 为什么人们会有脂肪？

paragraphs.en: Don’t be fooled: A lot of animals that look fat, like a hippopotamus, actually aren’t. Hippos only have around 2% body fat, the percentage of how much of your body mass comes from fat; while the average human woman has over 30% body fat.
paragraphs.zh: 不要被愚弄：很多看起来很胖的动物，比如河马，实际上并不胖。河马只有2%左右的体脂，这是体重中脂肪的百分比;而人类女性的平均体脂率超过30%。

paragraphs.en: In the rest of the animal kingdom, biologists typically only see a lot of body fat among hibernating or marine mammals. For the hibernators, the fat serves as energy storage for long, cold winters. For marine mammals like seals and whales, that extra fat is like a giant puffy coat helping to keep them warm in the cold depths of the ocean.
paragraphs.zh: 在动物王国的其他地方，生物学家通常只在冬眠或海洋哺乳动物中看到大量的身体脂肪。对于冬眠动物来说，脂肪是漫长寒冷冬季的能量储存。对于海豹和鲸鱼等海洋哺乳动物来说，多余的脂肪就像一件巨大的蓬松外套，帮助它们在寒冷的海洋深处保持温暖。

paragraphs.en: Humans do not hibernate, nor do we live in the ocean, so why do we have a lot more fat than all other primates and most mammals?
paragraphs.zh: 人类不冬眠，也不生活在海洋中，那么为什么我们比其他所有灵长类动物和大多数哺乳动物都有更多的脂肪呢？

paragraphs.en: Anthropologists like me, who study how the human body has evolved over time, think it has to do with the lifestyle of our evolutionary ancestors who had to gather and hunt to survive. Gathering and hunting were not always reliable food sources. We think our ancestors developed the ability to put on extra fat as a food insurance policy. When food was difficult to find, they could rely on their extra fat stores to carry them through until food became available again.
paragraphs.zh: 像我这样研究人类身体如何随着时间的推移而进化的人类学家认为，这与我们进化祖先的生活方式有关，他们不得不采集和狩猎以生存。采集和狩猎并不总是可靠的食物来源。我们认为，我们的祖先发展了增加额外脂肪的能力，作为食物保险政策。当食物很难找到时，它们可以依靠多余的脂肪储存来维持生命，直到食物再次出现。

paragraphs.en: Researchers are still trying to determine when this extra fat storage evolved. We have one line of evidence from small stone figures known as Gravettian statues.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员仍在试图确定这种额外的脂肪储存是何时进化而来的。我们有一条证据来自被称为格拉维特雕像的小石头雕像。

paragraphs.en: These ancient statues from 25,000 to 28,000 years ago depict feminine figures who carry a lot of extra body fat. Archaeologists have found them all throughout Europe and Russia.
paragraphs.zh: 这些25,000至28,000年前的古代雕像描绘了女性人物，他们携带了大量额外的身体脂肪。考古学家在欧洲和俄罗斯都发现了它们。

paragraphs.en: The way the ancient artists depicted fat on these figures matches how fat looks on bodies today. This accuracy has led researchers to believe that the makers of the Gravettian statues knew how individuals with greater body fat actually looked, meaning at least some people at this time did put on a lot of extra fat.
paragraphs.zh: 古代艺术家在这些雕像上描绘脂肪的方式与今天的身体脂肪的样子相吻合。这种准确性使研究人员相信，格拉维特雕像的制造者知道身体脂肪更大的人实际上是什么样子，这意味着至少当时有些人确实增加了很多额外的脂肪。

paragraphs.en: Europe and Russia back then were much colder than they are today, supporting the idea that our ancestors would have needed the extra fat to get through the extremely cold winters when food was harder to find.
paragraphs.zh: 当时的欧洲和俄罗斯比现在冷得多，这支持了我们的祖先需要额外的脂肪来度过食物难以找到的极端寒冷的冬天的想法。

paragraphs.en: So, the next time you poke at your butt fat, remember that fat is a really important part of our bodies, performs lots of different functions, and is likely evolutionarily ancient for us humans.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，下次你戳你的屁股脂肪，记住脂肪是我们身体的一个非常重要的部分，执行许多不同的功能，对我们人类来说可能是进化的古老。

paragraphs.en: Hello, curious kids! Do you have a question you’d like an expert to answer? Ask an adult to send your question to CuriousKidsUS@theconversation.com. Please tell us your name, age and the city where you live.
paragraphs.zh: 你好，好奇的孩子们！你有什么问题想让专家回答吗？请一位成年人将你的问题发送到CuriousKidsUS@theconnation.com。请告诉我们你的姓名、年龄和居住的城市。

paragraphs.en: And since curiosity has no age limit – adults, let us know what you’re wondering, too. We won’t be able to answer every question, but we will do our best.
paragraphs.zh: 由于好奇心没有年龄限制-成年人，让我们知道你想知道什么，太。我们将无法回答每一个问题，但我们会尽我们所能。
